title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (2/20): The Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge
note_en: Chinese needs a measure word between a number and a noun, and 座 is the one for large, fixed structures such as bridges, buildings, cities, and mountains: 三座城市 "three cities," 两座人工岛 "two artificial islands," 这座大桥 "this bridge." English attaches numbers straight to nouns, but in Chinese 三城市 or 这大桥 would sound wrong; the measure word also follows demonstratives like 这 and 那.
